notes: #5 is low resolution (1040 px) and has a small paper loss at the right, but it is a flat scan of the 1588 plate; #1 (1594 edition, 5000 px) is the same plate in a bound book with the fold through the town, so swap it in only if the fold is acceptable. #10 is undated beyond the Rijksmuseum’s 1744–87 range (Dall’Acqua’s working life); #11 and #9/#12 are other plates of the same series. #3, #4 and #6 are other 16th–17th-century bird’s-eye views (#4 Valesio 1640, #6 Bertelli 1599) if a different P1 plate is preferred.
